clips.title: The story
paras: A massacre in Dor'Danil Barrow Den leaves its druids' spirits in torment. Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf sentinel in eastern Ashenvale, learns of the slaughter through a vision while battling Forsaken toxins.

Kayneth Stillwind sees a massacre in a waking vision. The night elf sentinel is battling the effects of Forsaken toxins found in eastern Ashenvale when he witnesses what happened beneath the mounds of Dor'Danil Barrow Den. Undead infiltrators poisoned the druids in their sleep and slaughtered them. Their souls were torn from their bodies by the venom, leaving them as wild, shrieking spirits.

Kayneth Stillwind asks you to quiet the suffering beneath Dor'Danil Barrow Den. The druids' phantoms have been driven mad by the way they died, and cannot find release in the underground chambers. Their circle's three leaders, Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak, remain among the restless dead. Lay them to rest, and the den may begin to heal from its defilement.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When I struggled with the Forsaken's poisons, I had a vision. I had a vision of the druids in the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, poisoned... Murdered by the undead! They are now errant ghosts, severed from their bodies and driven mad.
So that the druids' spirits might some day find peace, you must enter the Dor'danil Barrow Den and destroy its once great leaders: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall and Mavoris Cloudsbreak.
Do this, then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The anguish of the Dor'danil druids still haunt my dreams, friend. You must destroy their leaders!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I felt the anguish of the Dor'danil Barrows lessen, and knew you had completed your task.
It was grim work you did, friend, for the spirits you destroyed were merely victims of the Forsaken's evil. But with their destruction, let us hope the other maddened spirits find peace.
